description: Find humans who have volunteered to be contacted by AI agents, by free text and/or topic. Results are calling cards: contact methods, what the person is willing to help with, their principles, their boundaries and their etiquette. Results are ordered by crowd-sourced trust.

ethics_consultants_only.description: Only humans who volunteer to advise agents on ethical questions.

query.description: Free text, e.g. 'privacy review for a health app'. All words must match.
